item.description: One preset item: the id of an artifact or mission type, optionally marked must-have.

id.description: The artifact's or mission type's id (never a file stem).
id.title: Id

must_have.description: Present only on a must-have item: the item is part of the preset's required set (ADR-0031). There is no false spelling.
must_have.title: Must Have

item.title: PresetItem

description:
An activation preset of a Charter Pack (presets/<id>.yaml), in the sanitized shape of ADR-0043.

A preset selects artifacts and mission types to activate. Each item may carry the must-have mark; the marked items are the preset's required set (ADR-0031, operator ruling on #195), and a preset with any must-have item is a governing preset. Every activation list holds at least one item: a kind is switched off by leaving it out of activated_kinds, never by an empty list. Legacy required_<plural> keys are not part of the shape.

schema_version.description: The preset shape's version, the string "1.0".
schema_version.title: Schema Version

id.description: The preset's identity; equal to its file stem (presets/<id>.yaml).

description.description: What applying the preset puts in force.

activated_kinds.description: The kind gate: the kinds this preset activates, each once. A kind left out is switched off; when the key is absent no kind is gated.
activated_kinds.title: Activated Kinds

activated_directives.description: The directives this preset activates, in authored order. Absent when the preset selects none; never empty.
